name: pulsating-button
title: Pulsating Button
description: An animated pulsating button useful for capturing attention of users.

0%, 100%.box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--pulse-color, oklch(from var(--bg) l c h / 0.5))

50%.box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--distance) var(--pulse-color, oklch(from var(--bg) l c h / 0.5))

0%.box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 oklch(from var(--pulse-color, var(--bg)) l c h / 1)

100%.box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--distance) oklch(from var(--pulse-color, var(--bg)) l c h / 0)

usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { PulsatingButton } from '@/components/ui/pulsating-button'
</script>

<template>
  <PulsatingButton>Join Affiliate Program</PulsatingButton>
</template>

props.name: pulseColor
props.description: Colour of the pulse. Defaults to the button's own background colour.

props.name: variant
props.description: `pulse` breathes in and out; `ripple` radiates outward and fades.

emits.name: click
emits.description: Native click (falls through to the button).
